none: PAS KENT-FBDF15: Nummus or Billon Antoninianus of Postumus. Reverse view.
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete, struck or hammered, base silver probably 20%, nummus or billon Antoninianus of Postumus, Userper in the West (260-268AD), founder of the 'Gallic Empire' which temporarly detached Britain from the Rule of the Central Government. Obverse: Draped, radiate bust right. Inscription: [IMP G POST](V)MV(S PF) [AVG]. Reverse: Possibly Salus Provinciarum, River God (the Rhine), sometimes horned reclining left, resting right hand on a boat and holding an anchor, left arm resting on an urn. Inscription: [SALVS PROV] (INC) [IARVM]. Mint: Possibly Cologne. Reece Period: 13. Die Axis: 6 o'clock. Broken two thirds only.
